description: This file defines the StepsScreen widget in a Flutter application, responsible for rendering problem steps, displaying a full solution modal, and managing the UI for navigating through problem-solving steps. It interacts with various other components like StepItem, StickyCtaBar, and provider classes.

classes.name: StepsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a list of steps with functionality to view the full solution and navigate through steps.

_ProblemCard.name: _ProblemCard
_ProblemCard.description: A stateless widget that displays the problem's description, source, and confidence.

_Tag.name: _Tag
_Tag.description: A widget representing a visual tag with an icon and label.

methods.name: _showFullSolution
methods.description: Builds and displays a modal bottom sheet that shows the full steps solution.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the StepsScreen, including app bar, list of steps, and sticky bottom CTA bar.
